title: Sheep waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='woolGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8e8f0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- fluffy wool body -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='58' r='14' fill='#f5f5ff'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='62' r='12' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='62' r='12' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='50' r='11' fill='#fafaff'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='50' r='11' fill='#f0f0fa'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='54' r='9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='54' r='9' fill='#f8f8ff'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='70' r='10' fill='#f5f5ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='70' r='10' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='76' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#c8a888'/>
  <rect x='48' y='76' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#c8a888'/>
  <rect x='28' y='87' width='10' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <rect x='46' y='87' width='10' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <!-- waving arm -->
  <rect x='58' y='44' width='6' height='18' rx='3' fill='#d8b898' transform='rotate(35 61 53)'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='42' r='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='44' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#c8a888'/>
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='40' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#d8b898'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='16' cy='40' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#b89878' transform='rotate(-20 16 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='38' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#b89878' transform='rotate(20 40 38)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='42' r='3' fill='#4a3a2a'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='42' r='3' fill='#4a3a2a'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='41' r='1' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='41' r='1' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M24 50 Q29 55 34 50' stroke='#7a5a3a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little cheeks -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='49' r='2.5' fill='#f0a0a0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='49' r='2.5' fill='#f0a0a0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- wool tuft on head -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='30' r='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='23' cy='32' r='4' fill='#fafaff'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='32' r='4' fill='#fafaff'/>
</svg>
